correctness.rationale: For q>=3 distinct circular runs, two consecutive equal-length residual arcs of size t<=L/2 cannot have equal Parikh vectors unless both are in a single monochromatic run; iterating yields a monochromatic chain of length e*t. If p mod L=r>L/2 use complementary length L-r windows in reverse order. Thus N(p,e)=Σ_i max(0,a_i-e*min(r,L-r)+1) for nonzero r; r=0 yields L. If ep<L only monochromatic qualifying strings count, D=Σ_i1_(a_i>=ep), otherwise primitive phase words are distinct and D=N. Direct independent phase-string enumeration for q=3,4 with all run lengths<=4, residues 0..L-1 (representing r=0 by period L), e=2,3,4 reproduced both N and D and phase qualification for 320 run profiles.
residual_risks: Finite cross-checks are corroboration, not universal proof.
